facts.fact: The Uganda Revenue Authority's UESW page says the single window is built on the ASYCUDA World platform and lists an upgrade of the customs ASYCUDA World system.
The Uganda Revenue Authority's UESW page says the Uganda Electronic Single Window has automated 22 of 30 border agencies, which can issue permits and certificates electronically.

UGA.note: Trade single window for traders and border agencies; no national services portal stated.
Document states nothing this study asks.
